problem: Only 30% of new users of our budgeting app finish setting up their first budget.

answers.common.decision: What the product team builds or fixes next in onboarding; the head of product decides.
answers.common.audience: The head of product and the onboarding squad.
answers.common.materials: We had 12,000 sign-ups last month. Of users who finish setup, 60% are still active a month later; for those who do not, 10% are still active. We received 1,500 support tickets about setup, and 900 were about connecting a bank account.
answers.data-analytics.data: Product event data for last month's sign-ups and support tickets tagged by topic.
answers.data-analytics.question: Where new users drop out of setup and what to fix first.
